complexity.notes: best_buy is dead code — it is updated each outer iteration but never used, since the profit is computed from prices[i] directly; its initializer of 100 would also be wrong for generalized prices above 100 if it ever were used. A better approach exists reaching O(n): a single pass tracking ||the minimum price seen so far and the best profit of selling today against that minimum||.
complexity.summary: Brute force: for each buy day i, scans every later sell day j and tracks the maximum profit, returning 0 if none is positive. Correct on all inputs, but quadratic.
